_fixture_note: SYNTHETIC. Two scarce response origins. Selection history, declared on structural criteria and recorded in full: (1) baseline must be feasible at the frozen 6.8 km allowance; (2) stressed share must fall in a 20-70% band so the fixture is neither vacuous nor saturated; (3) no single corridor failure may isolate a depot outright. A single depot at int_delhi_gate satisfied (1) but failed (3): four corridors cut it off entirely, leaving 8 of 9 critical facilities unreachable and saturating the fixture at 57% f1-alone. A second origin at int_connaught_place (co-located with fire_dfs_hq, the Delhi Fire Service HQ, criticality 10) removes that single point of failure. The earlier two-depot pair int_civil_lines + int_delhi_gate covered both ends of the arterial ring and was too robust (14% stressed), which produced zero two-failure interaction cases.
